newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial says production unaffected by fire.
newsitem.headline: Imperial says production unaffected by fire.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said on Friday that output would not be affected by a fire at its 80,000-barrel-per-day refinery in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia.
Imperial said earlier that a fire in the refinery's atmospheric and vapour distillation unit was extinguished early on Friday.
"The unit was coming down for a planned shutdown, so there really will not be any impact," said Imperial spokesman Richard O'Farrell.
O'Farrell said Imperial built up inventories and arranged for alternative supply in advance of the 28-day shutdown of the unit.
"So, from a supply point of view or a customer point of view, there would be now impact," he said.
